answer: What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The timber is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jade. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
